text: Each reference environment shall have exactly one application agent `main`, with application interrupts, NMI entry, async reentry, other threads/CPUs, concurrent foreign writers/callbacks, and DMA mutation excluded by explicit environment gating. Enabling another agent shall violate these profile versions.
